ItemId.description: The plan's 26-character id. When it matches a stored plan, that plan is updated.

Rule.description: The recurrence rule (RFC 5545), such as FREQ=MONTHLY;BYMONTHDAY=1.

StartDate.description: The day of the first run, yyyy-MM-dd.

EndDate.description: The last day a run can happen, yyyy-MM-dd.

MaxRuns.description: How many runs the plan makes in all.

Status.description: Draft, Active, Paused, Completed or Canceled.

Lines.description: The lines of each invoice, as on an invoice; {{ period.start }}, {{ period.end }}, {{ period.month }} and {{ period.year }} are written in.

Plans.description: The recurring plans to create or update.
